name: Trains
description: Create trains run on their own track network and carry glued-together blocks as cars.

pages.title: Trains
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Lay **Train Track** by clicking a placed track, then another spot.
- A station's **Assembly Mode** builds a train: Train Casing for bogeys, glued blocks, Train Controls.
- A train can only be turned back into blocks at a station.

Create trains run on their own track network and carry [#](7A3C9A)[glued](entry://glossary/super_glue)[#]()-together blocks as cars. You can drive one yourself or hand it a schedule.\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Tip:** hold W over any item here to watch its [#](2E5AAC)[Ponder](entry://start_here/tools)[#]().

pages.title: Track
pages.text: Train Track is **its own block**, not a vanilla rail. Click a placed track, then another spot, to lay a straight, a curve or a slope in one go. Sprint while connecting for the longest bend that fits. Blocks in your off-hand are paved under the track.

pages.title: Train Track
pages.text: Placed against a Nether portal, track builds a matching line on the other side, so trains can cross dimensions.

pages.title: Stations
pages.text: A **Train Station** is a waypoint on your network. Place it beside a track and open its screen. [#](7A3C9A)[Assembly Mode](entry://glossary/assemble)[#]() builds a train, and scheduled trains stay away while it is on. A train can **only be turned back into blocks at a station**.

pages.title: Train Station
pages.text: Use a map on a station to add a labelled marker at that spot. Assembled trains can be nudged onto nearby track with a [#](2E5AAC)[wrench](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]().

pages.title: Bogeys and controls
pages.text:
Use **Train Casing** on a track to place a [#](7A3C9A)[bogey](entry://glossary/bogey)[#](), the wheel unit a car rides on.

- Click the track again to cycle designs.
- Glue blocks on with Super Glue.
- Every train needs **Train Controls**. A second set facing the other way lets it leave a station in either direction.

pages.title: Train Casing
pages.text: Used on a track it places a bogey. Small and large bogeys are available.

pages.title: Train Controls
pages.text: Right-click once assembled to drive. Movement keys steer, the mouse wheel sets top speed, sneak lets go.

pages.title: Fuel and driving
pages.text:
A train moves faster if it finds fuel in chests or barrels glued to it. Vault fuel is not burned. Hold space while driving to roll up to a station.\
\
Track works in [#](7A3C9A)[unloaded chunks](entry://glossary/chunk)[#](): trains still travel and stop, but on-board machines wait until a player is near.
